additional_hard_findings: The earlier physical F-GC02 harness numerically treated prescribed bottom pressure head as coupling head after cm-to-m conversion. GC17 intentionally does not preserve that shortcut: direct groundwater coupling requires a common hydraulic datum and lower-boundary elevation so H_SWAP=z_bottom+psi_bottom.
Native SWAP qbot is cm/day positive into SWAP; public q_SWAP is m/s positive leaving SWAP. The conversion and sign reversal are now explicit and tested.
H_interface_tol defaults to an invalid zero carrier and becomes usable only with explicit externally governed qualified provenance.
F-GC17 does not bind H_interface_tol to H_app or A_temporal. That compatibility/allocation remains owned by F-GC22.
canonical_drift_disposition: F-CI49P changed no src/ files after the GC17 branch base. Owner qualification remains source-valid; canonical admission must still use a clean then-current canonical composition rather than direct merge by assumption.
